title: Pterostilbene targets the molecular oscillator RORgamma to restore circadian rhythm oscillation and protect against sleep restriction induced metabolic disorders.
authors: Zhang, Jun; Chang, Mengyun; Wang, Xiaolei; Zhou, Xi; Bai, Qian; Lang, Hedong; Zhang, Qianyong; Yi, Long; Mi, Mantian; Chen, Ka
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫檀芪通过分子对接靶向RORgamma恢复昼夜节律并改善睡眠限制代谢紊乱，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Considerable researches have directed toward metabolic disorders caused by sleep restriction (SR). SR-induced disruption of circadian metabolic rhythmicity is identified as an important pathophysiological mechanism. The flavonoid pterostilbene (PTE) is abundant in the traditional Chinese medicine dragon's blood with protective efficacy against obesity-related metabolic dysfunctions. Our previous study found that PTE ameliorates exercise intolerance and clock gene oscillation in the skeletal muscles subjected to SR. PURPOSE: This study aimed to explore whether PTE improves SR-induced metabolic disorders and delineate the relationship between PTE and the circadian clock. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Two hundred male C57/B6J mice were kept awake for 20 h/d over five consecutive days and concurrently gavaged with 50, 100, or 200 mg/kg.bw/d PTE. Food consumption and body weight were monitored, and the metabolic status of the mice was evaluated by performing OGTT and ITT, measuring the serum lipid profiles and liver histopathology in response to SR. Daily behavior was analyzed by Clocklab. The circadian rhythms of the liver clock genes and metabolic output genes were evaluated by cosine analysis. Binding between PTE and RORalpha/gamma or NR1D1/2 was investigated by molecular docking. A luciferase reporter assay was used to determine the impact of PTE on Bmal1 transcription in SR-exposed mice co-transfected with Ad-BMAL1-LUC plus Ad-RORgamma-mCherry or Ad-NR1D1-EGFP. RESULTS: PTE significantly ameliorated abnormal glucose and lipid metabolism (p < 0.05) in SR-exposed mice. PTE improved circadian behavior (p < 0.05) and rescued the circadian rhythm oscillation of the liver clock (p < 0.05) and metabolic output genes (p < 0.05) under SR condition. Molecular docking disclosed that PTE might interact with RORs, and PTE was found to increase Bmal1 promoter luciferase activity with RORE elements in the presence of Ad-RORgamma-mCherry (p < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: PTE may protect against SR-induced metabolic disorders by directly modulating RORgamma to maintain circadian metabolic rhythm. The findings provide valuable insights into the potential use of PTE in the treatment of metabolic disorders associated with disruptions in the circadian rhythm.
abstract_zh: 背景：大量研究关注睡眠限制（SR）引起的代谢紊乱。SR诱导的昼夜节律代谢节律性破坏被认为是重要的病理生理机制。黄酮类化合物紫檀芪（PTE）在传统中药龙血竭中含量丰富，对肥胖相关代谢功能障碍具有保护作用。我们先前的研究发现，PTE可改善SR条件下骨骼肌中的运动不耐受和时钟基因振荡。目的：本研究旨在探讨PTE是否改善SR诱导的代谢紊乱，并阐明PTE与昼夜节律时钟之间的关系。研究设计与方法：将200只雄性C57/B6J小鼠连续五天每天保持清醒20小时，同时以50、100或200 mg/kg.bw/d的剂量灌胃PTE。监测食物摄入量和体重，并通过进行OGTT和ITT、测量血清脂质谱和肝脏组织病理学来评估小鼠对SR的代谢状态。使用Clocklab分析每日行为。通过余弦分析评估肝脏时钟基因和代谢输出基因的昼夜节律。通过分子对接研究PTE与RORalpha/gamma或NR1D1/2之间的结合。使用荧光素酶报告基因测定法，在共转染Ad-BMAL1-LUC加Ad-RORgamma-mCherry或Ad-NR1D1-EGFP的SR暴露小鼠中，确定PTE对Bmal1转录的影响。结果：PTE显著改善了SR暴露小鼠中异常的葡萄糖和脂质代谢（p < 0.05）。PTE改善了昼夜节律行为（p < 0.05），并在SR条件下恢复了肝脏时钟（p < 0.05）和代谢输出基因（p < 0.05）的昼夜节律振荡。分子对接显示PTE可能与RORs相互作用，且发现PTE在存在Ad-RORgamma-mCherry时增加了含RORE元件的Bmal1启动子荧光素酶活性（p < 0.05）。结论：PTE可能通过直接调节RORgamma以维持昼夜节律代谢节律，从而保护免受SR诱导的代谢紊乱。这些发现为PTE在治疗与昼夜节律紊乱相关的代谢疾病中的潜在应用提供了宝贵见解。
